overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the July 7 notice topic on Select Board leadership was specific enough, and the Board need not list every tangential topic. Resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the July 7 notice topic on Select Board leadership was too vague because it did not mention a vice chair deliberation and vote.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the topic as listed sufficiently identified the discussions that occurred, which were essentially about the leadership of the Board.
